svg.title: Known-best packing of 268 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=268 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-17 exact rational centre-direction certificate at 268, read exactly from the retained source file n268/n268_exact.json at a1ba501, in the watched repository JoostdeWinter/square-packing, which jlevy/squares#1021 names: a slice composition of nine diagonal slices from published packings of 129, 153 and 302 squares. Finite construction feasibility only; local optimum, KKT, rigidity, same-packing, novelty, priority and global optimality are not replayed here.

svg.text: U n=268 known best: side ~ 16.87001385 (certified upper bound)
